info.title: CSV-to-MongoDB Schema Normalizer
info.description: Prevents production data corruption by automatically detecting and normalizing inconsistent field types (e.g., '123' vs 123) in CSV data before MongoDB ingestion, ensuring schema consistency without manual ETL scripting. Includes 50 free monthly tier with hard lock for B2B paywall.
